name: ORANO (Remote)
description: Connects to the hosted ORANO MCP endpoint: personal, read-only tools that let your own AI agent search and read the library of summaries, key takeaways, plans and memory facts you saved in ORANO. Requires an ORANO account and a personal API key (created in the ORANO app) sent as a Bearer token; the key is not modeled in this registry entry.
author: ORANO
